messages.subject: SEM Multigroup using logit link
parts:
Hi all,

2 Questions:

1.  I am attempting a multigroup logistic regression using Lavaan, however, when using 
fit<-sem(model, data=mydata, group='group', link='logit'),  Lavaan defaults to a probit link when estimator=ML. Does this mean that logit link has not yet been implemented for multigroup analysis or is there a way to ensure logit is used for regressions within groups?

2. When running a simple probit glm within a group outside of Lavaan, the results differ from the probit link in lavaan. Is there a scaling parameter to be aware of within Lavaan which would contribute to different results?

Thanks, 

Arif
